scenario: LUNI.3.1.1 gives `45°`, `30′` and `45″` as valid literals and `45_arcsec` as the word-form. PATH PINNED: the lexer half is `dsc.lex.llex_12_3_take_unit_suffix`, which takes `°`, `′` and `″` (U+2032 / U+2033) into a unit suffix through `llex_12_2_unit_glyph`; the symbol half is `dsc.resolve.add_unit_alias`, which makes each `alias` an input symbol. A `label` is display-only — only the canonical name and explicit `alias` entries become input symbols — so `label "arcsec"` does not make `arcsec` writable. This pins all four forms at once, and pins them through an alias rather than a canonical name so a regression in either half (lexer or symbol table) fails it.
rules_ds:
unit dimension angle storage float64 base radian
unit radian: angle
unit degree: angle = x * 0.017453292519943295 alias deg, °
unit arcminute: angle = x * 0.0002908882086657216 alias arcmin, ′
unit arcsecond: angle = x * 0.00000484813681109536 alias arcsec, ″

schema Bearing scope logical:
    id: String key
    heading: Float mutable

rule degree_glyph:
    Bearing b where b.heading::degree > 45°
->
    log info "degree glyph"

rule arcminute_glyph:
    Bearing b where b.heading::degree > 30′
->
    log info "arcminute glyph"

rule arcsecond_glyph:
    Bearing b where b.heading::degree > 45″
->
    log info "arcsecond glyph"

rule arcsecond_word_form:
    Bearing b where b.heading::degree > 45_arcsec
->
    log info "arcsec word form"
